standard.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval.

standard.name: upper_ci
standard.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval.

standard.name: r_squared
standard.description: R-squared of the regression for this period (repeated per row).

/quantitative/risk_decomposition.description:
Decompose Var(target) into per-factor contributions plus residual variance.

For each look-back period, runs OLS of the target on the factor matrix and
splits the target's variance via the additive identity
`Var(target) = sum_i beta_i * Cov(factor_i, target) + Var(residual)`.
Returned shares sum to 1 per period: factor shares sum to R^2 and the residual
row holds `1 - R^2`. Handles correlated factors cleanly because each share is
measured by the covariance with the target rather than by the factor's
standalone variance.

standard.name: data
standard.type: Data | DataFrame | Series | dict | list | list[DataFrame] | list[Data] | list[Series] | ndarray
standard.description: Target time series (index column plus the target column).

standard.name: factors_data
standard.description: Factor matrix (index column plus one column per factor).

standard.name: periods
standard.description: Named look-back periods to decompose over, anchored to the latest factor observation.

standard.name: target
standard.description: Name of the column in `data` to decompose against the factors.

standard.name: index
standard.description: Name of the index column shared by `data` and `factors_data`.

standard.name: risk_free_column
standard.description: Optional name of the risk-free rate column in `factors_data`. When provided, the target is converted to excess returns before decomposition and the column is dropped from the factor set.

standard.name: chart
standard.description: Whether to create a chart or not, by default False.

standard.name: period
standard.description: Look-back period the decomposition was run over.

standard.name: factor
standard.description: Factor name, or 'Residual' for the idiosyncratic component.

standard.name: contribution
standard.description: Covariance-based contribution to Var(target): for a factor, beta_i * Cov(factor_i, target); for 'Residual', Var(target) * (1 - R^2).

standard.name: share
standard.description: Fraction of Var(target) attributed to this factor (or to the residual). Factor shares sum to R^2; the residual share equals 1 - R^2.

/quantitative/attribution.description:
Decompose the target's total return into per-factor contributions plus alpha
and residual.

For each look-back period, runs OLS of the target on the factor matrix and
splits the period's cumulative target return via the identity
`sum_t y_t = alpha * n + sum_i beta_i * sum_t f_{i,t} + sum_t residual_t`.
The three components are returned as rows: one per factor, one `Alpha`, and one
`Residual`. Use with arithmetic (additive) returns; for geometric compounding,
convert returns to log-returns before passing in.

standard.name: data
standard.type: Data | DataFrame | Series | dict | list | list[DataFrame] | list[Data] | list[Series] | ndarray
standard.description: Target time series (index column plus the target column).

standard.name: factors_data
standard.description: Factor matrix (index column plus one column per factor).

standard.name: periods
standard.description: Named look-back periods to attribute over, anchored to the latest factor observation.

standard.name: target
standard.description: Name of the column in `data` to attribute across the factors.

standard.name: index
standard.description: Name of the index column shared by `data` and `factors_data`.

standard.name: risk_free_column
standard.description: Optional name of the risk-free rate column in `factors_data`. When provided, the target is converted to excess returns before attribution and the column is dropped from the factor set.

standard.name: chart
standard.description: Whether to create a chart or not, by default False.

standard.name: period
standard.description: Look-back period the attribution was run over.

standard.name: factor
standard.description: Factor name, 'Alpha' for the intercept contribution, or 'Residual' for the unexplained residual.

standard.name: contribution
standard.description: Component's contribution to the period's total target return: for a factor, beta_i * sum_t factor_i; for 'Alpha', alpha * n; for 'Residual', sum of regression residuals. The three sum to the period's total target return.

standard.name: share
standard.description: Component's contribution divided by the total target return over the period. Shares sum to 1.0 unless the total return is zero.

/sec/schema_files.description:
Explore SEC and FASB XBRL taxonomy schemas, labels, and presentation structures.

- No parameters: list all available taxonomy families.
- taxonomy only: get all parsed structures for the most recent year.
- taxonomy + year: get all parsed structures for a specific year.
- taxonomy + component: get one component's structure using the most recent year.
- taxonomy + year + component: get one component's parsed structure.
/sec/schema_files.examples:
Examples
--------

```python
from openbb import obb
obb.sec.schema_files(provider='sec')
# Explore XBRL taxonomies progressively.
# List all available taxonomy families
obb.sec.schema_files(provider='sec')
# List components for US GAAP (latest year)
obb.sec.schema_files(taxonomy='us-gaap', provider='sec')
# List presentation components for US GAAP 2024
obb.sec.schema_files(taxonomy='us-gaap', year=2024, provider='sec')
# Get the Statement of Income presentation structure
obb.sec.schema_files(taxonomy='us-gaap', year=2024, component='soi', provider='sec')
```

standard.name: symbol
standard.description: Symbol to get data for.

standard.name: limit
standard.description: The number of data entries to return.

sec.name: period
sec.description: Time period of the data to return. For balance sheet, TTM is treated as the average of the last 4 quarters.

sec.name: use_cache
sec.description: Whether to use cache (4-hour memory) for the SEC request. Defaults to True.

sec.name: include_preliminary
sec.description: Whether to include preliminary data from 8-K filings for periods not yet reported on 10-Q/K.

sec.name: pit_mode
sec.description: Point-in-time mode. When True, returns data as originally reported at the time of filing, without subsequent restatements or amendments. For annual data, uses the original 10-K values. For quarterly data, preserves 10-Q filing vintage instead of using restated comparatives from the 10-K.

standard.name: period_ending
standard.description: The end date of the reporting period.

standard.name: fiscal_period
standard.description: The fiscal period of the report.

standard.name: fiscal_year
standard.description: The fiscal year of the fiscal period.

sec.name: reported_currency
sec.description: The currency in which the balance sheet is reported.

sec.name: cash_and_equivalents
sec.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

sec.name: restricted_cash
sec.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

sec.name: short_term_investments
sec.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

sec.name: fed_funds_sold
sec.description: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).

sec.name: interest_bearing_deposits_at_other_banks
sec.description: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

sec.name: time_deposits_placed
sec.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

sec.name: trading_account_securities
sec.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

sec.name: loans_and_leases
sec.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

sec.name: allowance_for_loan_and_lease_losses
sec.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

sec.name: net_loans_and_leases
sec.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

sec.name: loans_held_for_sale
sec.description: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

sec.name: accrued_investment_income
sec.description: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

sec.name: accounts_receivable
sec.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

sec.name: customer_and_other_receivables
sec.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

sec.name: note_receivable
sec.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

sec.name: nontrade_receivables
sec.description: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: net_inventory
sec.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: prepaid_expenses
sec.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: current_deferred_tax_assets
sec.description: The current portion of the aggregate tax effects as of the balance sheet date of all future tax deductions arising from temporary differences between tax basis and generally accepted accounting principles basis recognition of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, which can only be deducted for tax purposes when permitted under enacted tax laws; after deducting the allocated valuation allowance, if any, to reduce such amount to net realizable value. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, are classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference. An unrecognized tax benefit that is directly related to a position taken in a tax year that results in a net operating loss carryforward is presented as a reduction of the related deferred tax asset.

sec.name: other_current_assets
sec.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

sec.name: other_current_nonoperating_assets
sec.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: total_current_assets
sec.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

sec.name: gross_ppe
sec.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

sec.name: accumulated_depreciation
sec.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

sec.name: net_ppe
sec.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

sec.name: net_premises_and_equipment
sec.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

sec.name: operating_lease_right_of_use_asset
sec.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

sec.name: finance_lease_right_of_use_asset
sec.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

sec.name: long_term_investments
sec.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

sec.name: mortgage_servicing_rights
sec.description: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

sec.name: deferred_acquisition_cost
sec.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

sec.name: separate_account_business_assets
sec.description: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.

sec.name: noncurrent_note_receivables
sec.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

sec.name: goodwill
sec.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

sec.name: intangible_assets
sec.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

sec.name: noncurrent_deferred_tax_assets
sec.description: The noncurrent portion as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate carrying amount of all future tax deductions arising from temporary differences between tax basis and generally accepted accounting principles basis recognition of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, which can only be deducted for tax purposes when permitted under enacted tax laws; after the valuation allowance, if any, to reduce such amount to net realizable value. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, is classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference.

sec.name: employee_benefit_assets
sec.description: This represents the entire assets recognized in the balance sheet that are associated with the defined benefit plans.

sec.name: other_noncurrent_assets
sec.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

sec.name: other_noncurrent_nonoperating_assets
sec.description: Amount of investments, and noncurrent assets classified as other.

sec.name: other_noncurrent_assets_excl_ppe
sec.description: Noncurrent assets other than investments and PP&E.

sec.name: total_noncurrent_assets
sec.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: other_assets
sec.description: Amount of assets classified as other.

sec.name: total_assets
sec.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

sec.name: noninterest_bearing_deposits
sec.description: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

sec.name: interest_bearing_deposits
sec.description: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

sec.name: fed_funds_purchased
sec.description: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

sec.name: short_term_debt
sec.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: current_portion_of_long_term_debt
sec.description: Amount of long-term debt due within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: bankers_acceptances
sec.description: Amount of short-term, negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by a financial institution. Bankers acceptances are a bank's promise to pay to the holder of the draft a stated amount on a specified date.

sec.name: accounts_payable
sec.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

sec.name: accrued_interest_payable
sec.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

sec.name: other_short_term_payables
sec.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: accrued_expenses
sec.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

sec.name: customer_deposits
sec.description: Carrying amount of liabilities for customer deposits received and held, classified as current. Includes cash received in advance for undelivered goods or services and refundable security deposits.

sec.name: dividends_payable
sec.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

sec.name: current_deferred_revenue
sec.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

sec.name: current_deferred_tax_liabilities
sec.description: Represents the current portion of deferred tax liabilities, which result from applying the applicable tax rate to net taxable temporary differences pertaining to each jurisdiction to which the entity is obligated to pay income tax. A current taxable temporary difference is a difference between the tax basis and the carrying amount of a current asset or liability in the financial statements prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. In a classified statement of financial position, an enterprise separates deferred tax liabilities and assets into a current amount and a noncurrent amount. Deferred tax liabilities and assets are classified as current or noncurrent based on the classification of the related asset or liability for financial reporting. A deferred tax liability or asset that is not related to an asset or liability for financial reporting, including deferred tax assets related to carryforwards, is classified according to the expected reversal date of the temporary difference.

sec.name: current_employee_benefit_liabilities
sec.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

sec.name: other_taxes_payable
sec.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

sec.name: other_current_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: other_current_nonoperating_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of current liabilities from nonoperating activities, classified as other. Includes accrued liabilities and other liabilities not separately disclosed.

sec.name: operating_lease_liability_current
sec.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

sec.name: finance_lease_liability_current
sec.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

sec.name: total_current_liabilities
sec.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

sec.name: long_term_debt
sec.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

sec.name: capital_lease_obligations
sec.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

sec.name: operating_lease_liability_noncurrent
sec.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

sec.name: claims_and_claim_expenses
sec.description: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

sec.name: future_policy_benefits
sec.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

sec.name: unearned_premiums_credit
sec.description: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

sec.name: policyholder_funds
sec.description: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.

sec.name: participating_policyholder_equity
sec.description: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.

sec.name: separate_account_business_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

sec.name: other_long_term_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: asset_retirement_and_litigation_obligation
sec.description: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

sec.name: noncurrent_deferred_revenue
sec.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

sec.name: noncurrent_deferred_tax_liabilities
sec.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

sec.name: noncurrent_employee_benefit_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

sec.name: other_noncurrent_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: other_noncurrent_nonoperating_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of noncurrent liabilities from nonoperating activities, classified as other. Includes deferred income taxes and other liabilities not separately disclosed.

sec.name: total_noncurrent_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: total_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

sec.name: commitments_and_contingencies
sec.description: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

sec.name: temporary_equity
sec.description: Carrying amount of the equity component of securities that are redeemable.

sec.name: temporary_equity_parent
sec.description: Carrying amount of temporary equity attributable to parent.

sec.name: redeemable_noncontrolling_interest
sec.description: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

sec.name: redeemable_nci_common
sec.description: Equity carrying amount of the common stock component of redeemable NCI.

sec.name: redeemable_nci_preferred
sec.description: Equity carrying amount of the preferred stock component of redeemable NCI.

sec.name: redeemable_nci_other
sec.description: Equity carrying amount of the other component of redeemable NCI.

sec.name: total_preferred_equity
sec.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

sec.name: common_equity
sec.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

sec.name: additional_paid_in_capital
sec.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

sec.name: retained_earnings
sec.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

sec.name: treasury_stock
sec.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

sec.name: accumulated_other_comprehensive_income
sec.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

sec.name: other_equity
sec.description: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

sec.name: total_common_equity
sec.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: total_equity
sec.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.


standard.name: symbol
standard.description: Symbol to get data for.

standard.name: limit
standard.description: The number of data entries to return.

sec.name: period
sec.description: Time period of the data to return.

sec.name: use_cache
sec.description: Whether to use cache (4-hour memory) for the SEC request. Defaults to True.

sec.name: include_preliminary
sec.description: Whether to include preliminary data from 8-K filings for periods not yet reported on 10-Q/K.

sec.name: pit_mode
sec.description: Point-in-time mode. When True, returns data as originally reported at the time of filing, without subsequent restatements or amendments. For annual data, uses the original 10-K values. For quarterly data, preserves 10-Q filing vintage instead of using restated comparatives from the 10-K.

standard.name: period_ending
standard.description: The end date of the reporting period.

standard.name: fiscal_period
standard.description: The fiscal period of the report.

standard.name: fiscal_year
standard.description: The fiscal year of the fiscal period.

sec.name: reported_currency
sec.description: The currency in which the cash flow statement is reported.

sec.name: net_income
sec.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: net_income_discontinued
sec.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

sec.name: net_income_continuing
sec.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: provision_for_loan_losses
sec.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

sec.name: depreciation_expense
sec.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

sec.name: amortization_expense
sec.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

sec.name: depreciation_and_amortization
sec.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

sec.name: stock_based_compensation
sec.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

sec.name: deferred_income_tax
sec.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

sec.name: gain_loss_on_investments
sec.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

sec.name: gain_loss_on_sale_of_assets
sec.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

sec.name: income_loss_from_equity_method_investments
sec.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

sec.name: asset_impairment_charges
sec.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

sec.name: noncash_adjustments_to_net_income
sec.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

sec.name: other_operating_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

sec.name: change_in_insurance_reserves
sec.description: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.

sec.name: change_in_accounts_receivable
sec.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

sec.name: change_in_nontrade_receivables
sec.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

sec.name: change_in_inventories
sec.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

sec.name: change_in_accounts_payable
sec.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

sec.name: change_in_other_operating_assets_and_liabilities
sec.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

sec.name: increase_decrease_in_operating_capital
sec.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

sec.name: net_cash_from_continuing_operating_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

sec.name: net_cash_from_discontinued_operating_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

sec.name: net_cash_from_operating_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

sec.name: purchase_of_plant_property_and_equipment
sec.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

sec.name: acquisitions
sec.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

sec.name: purchase_of_investments
sec.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

sec.name: purchase_of_held_to_maturity_investments
sec.description: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

sec.name: sale_of_plant_property_and_equipment
sec.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

sec.name: sale_of_productive_assets
sec.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

sec.name: divestitures
sec.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

sec.name: sale_of_investments
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

sec.name: maturity_of_investments
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

sec.name: net_increase_in_fed_funds_sold
sec.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

sec.name: loans_held_for_sale_net
sec.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

sec.name: other_investing_activities_net
sec.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

sec.name: net_cash_from_continuing_investing_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

sec.name: net_cash_from_discontinued_investing_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

sec.name: net_cash_from_investing_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

sec.name: repayment_of_debt
sec.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: repurchase_of_preferred_equity
sec.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

sec.name: repurchase_of_common_equity
sec.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

sec.name: payment_of_dividends
sec.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

sec.name: issuance_of_debt
sec.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: issuance_of_preferred_equity
sec.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

sec.name: issuance_of_common_equity
sec.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

sec.name: net_change_in_deposits
sec.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

sec.name: short_term_debt_net
sec.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

sec.name: tax_withholding_share_based_compensation
sec.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

sec.name: other_financing_activities_net
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

sec.name: net_cash_from_continuing_financing_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

sec.name: net_cash_from_discontinued_financing_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

sec.name: net_cash_from_financing_activities
sec.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

sec.name: effect_of_exchange_rate_changes
sec.description: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash balances held in foreign currencies.

sec.name: net_cash_from_discontinued_operations
sec.description: The net change in cash and cash equivalents resulting from the cash inflows and outflows of discontinued operations.

sec.name: other_net_changes_in_cash
sec.description: Amount of other net changes in cash and cash equivalents not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows.

sec.name: net_change_in_cash
sec.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash and cash equivalents. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a debit balance consistent with its label.

sec.name: cash_at_beginning_of_period
sec.description: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents at the beginning of the reporting period. Derived from the previous period's ending balance.

sec.name: cash_at_end_of_period
sec.description: Cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and restricted cash equivalents at the end of the reporting period.

sec.name: cash_interest_paid
sec.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

sec.name: cash_interest_received
sec.description: The cash inflow from interest received, classified as operating activities.

sec.name: cash_income_taxes_paid
sec.description: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

/sec/income_statement.description: Get the income statement for a given company.
/sec/income_statement.examples:
Examples
--------

```python
from openbb import obb
obb.sec.income_statement(symbol='AAPL', provider='sec')
obb.sec.income_statement(symbol='AAPL', period='annual', limit=5, provider='sec')
```

standard.name: symbol
standard.description: Symbol to get data for.

standard.name: limit
standard.description: The number of data entries to return.

sec.name: period
sec.description: Time period of the data to return.

sec.name: use_cache
sec.description: Whether to use cache (4-hour memory) for the SEC request. Defaults to True.

sec.name: include_preliminary
sec.description: Whether to include preliminary data from 8-K filings for periods not yet reported on 10-Q/K.

sec.name: pit_mode
sec.description: Point-in-time mode. When True, returns data as originally reported at the time of filing, without subsequent restatements or amendments. For annual data, uses the original 10-K values. For quarterly data, preserves 10-Q filing vintage instead of using restated comparatives from the 10-K.

standard.name: period_ending
standard.description: The end date of the reporting period.

standard.name: fiscal_period
standard.description: The fiscal period of the report.

standard.name: fiscal_year
standard.description: The fiscal year of the fiscal period.

sec.name: reported_currency
sec.description: The currency in which the income statement is reported.

sec.name: operating_revenue
sec.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

sec.name: other_revenue
sec.description: Revenues from the sale of other goods or rendering of other services, not elsewhere specified in the taxonomy; net of (reduced by) sales adjustments, returns, allowances, and discounts.

sec.name: total_revenue
sec.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

sec.name: operating_cost_of_revenue
sec.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

sec.name: other_cost_of_revenue
sec.description: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

sec.name: total_cost_of_revenue
sec.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

sec.name: excise_and_sales_taxes
sec.description: Amount of excise and sales taxes included in revenue.

sec.name: total_gross_profit
sec.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

sec.name: sga_expense
sec.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

sec.name: rd_expense
sec.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

sec.name: exploration_expense
sec.description: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or 'G&G' costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

sec.name: depreciation_expense
sec.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

sec.name: amortization_expense
sec.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

sec.name: depreciation_and_amortization
sec.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.

sec.name: depletion_expense
sec.description: The noncash expense charged against earnings to recognize the consumption of natural resources.

sec.name: other_operating_expenses
sec.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

sec.name: impairment_expense
sec.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

sec.name: restructuring_charge
sec.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

sec.name: other_special_charges
sec.description: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

sec.name: total_operating_expenses
sec.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

sec.name: costs_and_expenses
sec.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

sec.name: total_operating_income
sec.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

sec.name: loans_and_lease_interest_income
sec.description: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.

sec.name: investment_securities_interest_income
sec.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

sec.name: deposits_interest_income
sec.description: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

sec.name: fed_funds_and_repo_interest_income
sec.description: The aggregate interest income earned from (1) the lending of excess federal funds to another commercial bank requiring such for its legal reserve requirements and (2) securities purchased under agreements to resell.

sec.name: trading_account_interest_income
sec.description: Interest and dividend income on securities that are bought and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term ('trading securities') and on securities measured at fair value through earnings.

sec.name: other_interest_income
sec.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

sec.name: total_interest_income
sec.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

sec.name: deposits_interest_expense
sec.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

sec.name: short_term_borrowing_interest_expense
sec.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

sec.name: long_term_debt_interest_expense
sec.description: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

sec.name: fed_funds_and_repo_interest_expense
sec.description: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

sec.name: capitalized_lease_obligation_interest_expense
sec.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

sec.name: other_interest_expense
sec.description: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

sec.name: total_interest_expense
sec.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

sec.name: net_interest_income
sec.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

sec.name: revenues_excl_interest_dividends
sec.description: Revenue excluding interest and dividend income (securities firms).

sec.name: trust_fee_income
sec.description: Revenue recognized in the period for (1) performance (incentive) fees based on the investment results achieved for management of certain institutional accounts and hedge funds, (2) schedule-based fees earned for management of mutual funds and closed-end funds, based either on average daily net assets or on a combination of the average daily net assets and gross income, and (3) other investment management and advisory fees.

sec.name: service_charges_on_deposits_income
sec.description: Includes amounts charged depositors for: (1) maintenance of their accounts (maintenance charges); (2) failure to maintain specified minimum balances on account; (3) exceeding the number of checks or transactions allowed to be processed in a given period; (4) checks drawn on no minimum balance deposit accounts; (5) withdrawals from nontransaction deposit accounts; (6) closing savings accounts before a specified minimum period of time has elapsed; (7) accounts which have remained inactive for extended periods of time or which have become dormant; (8) use of automated teller machines or remote service units; (9) checks drawn against insufficient funds that the bank assesses regardless of whether it decides to pay, return or hold the check; (10) issuing stop payment orders; (11) certifying checks; and (12) accumulating or disbursing funds deposited in IRAs or Keogh Plan accounts when not handled by the bank's trust department. This item does not include penalties assessed on the early withdrawal of time deposits.

sec.name: other_service_charge_income
sec.description: Fee and commission revenue earned from sources not otherwise specified in the existing taxonomy.

sec.name: net_realized_capital_gains
sec.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

sec.name: premiums_earned
sec.description: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

sec.name: investment_banking_income
sec.description: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

sec.name: other_noninterest_income
sec.description: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

sec.name: total_noninterest_income
sec.description: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

sec.name: provision_for_credit_losses
sec.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

sec.name: net_interest_income_after_provision
sec.description: Amount of net interest income after provision for credit losses.

sec.name: benefits_costs_expenses
sec.description: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

sec.name: current_and_future_benefits
sec.description: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for health insurance contracts.

sec.name: salaries_and_employee_benefits_expense
sec.description: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

sec.name: net_occupancy_equipment_expense
sec.description: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

sec.name: marketing_expense
sec.description: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.

sec.name: property_liability_insurance_claims
sec.description: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

sec.name: policy_acquisition_costs
sec.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

sec.name: amortization_of_deferred_policy_acquisition_costs
sec.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs.

sec.name: total_noninterest_expense
sec.description: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

sec.name: non_operating_income
sec.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

sec.name: other_income
sec.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

sec.name: other_gains
sec.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

sec.name: total_other_income
sec.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

sec.name: total_pretax_income
sec.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: income_tax_expense
sec.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

sec.name: income_tax_current
sec.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

sec.name: income_tax_deferred
sec.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

sec.name: income_before_equity_method
sec.description: Amount of income/loss from continuing operations before income from equity method investments.

sec.name: equity_method_investments
sec.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

sec.name: net_income_continuing
sec.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: net_income_discontinued
sec.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

sec.name: extraordinary_income
sec.description: Description of the gains (losses), after tax, arising from an event or transaction that is both unusual in nature and infrequent in occurrence when considered in relation to the environment in which the entity operates and which represents the portion assigned to noncontrolling interest, if any. This amount is the income statement amount which is allocable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

sec.name: other_adjustments_to_consolidated_net_income
sec.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

sec.name: gain_on_sale_properties
sec.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, net of applicable income taxes.

sec.name: gain_loss_disposition_subsidiary
sec.description: Gain/loss on sale of stock in subsidiary or equity method investee.

sec.name: net_income
sec.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: preferred_dividends
sec.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

sec.name: net_income_nci_redeemable
sec.description: Amount after tax of income attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: net_income_nci_nonredeemable
sec.description: Amount after tax of income attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: net_income_to_noncontrolling_interest
sec.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

sec.name: other_adjustments_to_net_income_to_common
sec.description: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

sec.name: net_income_to_common
sec.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

sec.name: weighted_ave_basic_shares_os
sec.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

sec.name: basic_eps
sec.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

sec.name: weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os
sec.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

sec.name: diluted_eps
sec.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

sec.name: weighted_ave_basic_diluted_shares_os
sec.description: Average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS).

sec.name: basic_diluted_eps
sec.description: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each share in instances when basic and diluted earnings per share are the same amount and reported as a single line item on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per share is the amount of net income or loss for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per share includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

sec.name: cash_dividends_per_share
sec.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

sec.name: other_comprehensive_income_parent
sec.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of OCI attributable to parent.

sec.name: comprehensive_income_parent
sec.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events, attributable to parent.

sec.name: other_comprehensive_income_nci
sec.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of OCI attributable to noncontrolling interests.

sec.name: comprehensive_income_nci
sec.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

sec.name: comprehensive_income
sec.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events/circumstances from net income and OCI. Includes portion attributable to NCI.

standard.name: symbol
standard.description: Symbol to get data for. Multiple items allowed for provider(s): sec.

standard.name: fact
standard.description: The fact to lookup, typically a GAAP-reporting measure. Choices vary by provider.

sec.name: fact
sec.description:
Fact or concept from the SEC taxonomy, in UpperCamelCase. Defaults to, 'Revenues'. AAPL, MSFT, GOOG, BRK-A currently report revenue as, 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax'. In previous years, they have reported as 'Revenues'.
Facts fall into two groups. Instantaneous balance-sheet concepts are measured at a point in time (e.g. 'Assets', 'Liabilities', 'StockholdersEquity', 'Goodwill', 'LongTermDebt'); the full set is openbb_sec.utils.definitions.INSTANT_FACTS. Everything else is a flow concept from the income or cash-flow statement, measured over a period (e.g. 'Revenues', 'NetIncomeLoss', 'NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities'). The 'instantaneous' parameter and the standalone-Q4 derivation apply only to flow concepts; balance-sheet concepts are always point-in-time, including the year-end (Q4) value.

sec.name: year
sec.description: The calendar year to retrieve the data for. If not provided, the current year is used. When symbol(s) are provided, excluding the year will return all reported values for the concept. Values are aligned by the calendar quarter/year of the period end, not the fiscal calendar.

sec.name: calendar_period
sec.description: The calendar period to retrieve the data for. Periods are aligned to the calendar quarter/year of the report period end, not the filer's fiscal calendar, so off-calendar filers stay comparable. If not provided, the most recent quarter is used. 'q1'-'q4' return standalone (3-month) quarters; the fourth quarter is derived as FY - 9-month. When a symbol is supplied, cumulative year-to-date values are reduced to standalone quarters.

sec.name: instantaneous
sec.description:
Whether to retrieve instantaneous data. See the notes above for more information. Defaults to False. Some facts are only available as instantaneous data.
The function will automatically attempt the inverse of this parameter if the initial calendar quarter request fails. This parameter is ignored when a symbol is supplied.

sec.name: use_cache
sec.description: Whether to use cache for the request. Defaults to True.

/sec/form_13f.description:
Get the form 13F.

The Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) Form 13F is a quarterly
report that is required to be filed by all institutional investment
managers with at least $100 million in assets under management.
Managers are required to file Form 13F within 45 days after the last
day of the calendar quarter. Most funds wait until the end of this
period in order to conceal their investment strategy from competitors
and the public.


/technical/sma.description: Calculate the Simple Moving Average over the trailing window.
/technical/sma.examples:
Examples
--------

```python
from openbb import obb
# 50-bar SMA on TSLA close.
data = obb.equity.price.historical(symbol='TSLA', start_date='2023-01-01', provider='fmp').results
sma = obb.technical.sma(data=data, length=50)
```

/uscongress/bills.description: Get and filter lists of Congressional Bills.
/uscongress/bills.examples:
Examples
--------

```python
from openbb import obb
obb.uscongress.bills(provider='congress_gov')
obb.uscongress.bills(start_date='2025-01-01', end_date='2025-01-31', provider='congress_gov')
# Get all bills of type 's' (Senate) for the 118th Congress.
obb.uscongress.bills(bill_type='s', congress=118, limit=0, provider='congress_gov')
```

congress_gov.name: congress
congress_gov.description: Congress number (e.g., 118 for the 118th Congress). The 103rd Congress started in 1993, which is the earliest date supporting full text versions. Each Congress spans two years, starting in odd-numbered years.

congress_gov.name: bill_type
congress_gov.description:
Bill type (e.g., 'hr' for House bills).

Must be one of: hr, s, hjres, sjres, hconres, sconres, hres, sres.

Bills
-----

A bill is the form used for most legislation, whether permanent or temporary, general or special, public or private.

A bill originating in the House of Representatives is designated by the letters “H.R.”,
signifying “House of Representatives”, followed by a number that it retains throughout all its parliamentary stages.

Bills are presented to the President for action when approved in identical form
by both the House of Representatives and the Senate.

Joint Resolutions
-----------------

Joint resolutions may originate either in the House of Representatives or in the Senate.

There is little practical difference between a bill and a joint resolution. Both are subject to the same procedure,
except for a joint resolution proposing an amendment to the Constitution.

On approval of such a resolution by two-thirds of both the House and Senate,
it is sent directly to the Administrator of General Services for submission to the individual states for ratification.

It is not presented to the President for approval.
A joint resolution originating in the House of Representatives is designated “H.J.Res.” followed by its individual number.
Joint resolutions become law in the same manner as bills.

Concurrent Resolutions
----------------------

Matters affecting the operations of both the House of Representatives and Senate
are usually initiated by means of concurrent resolutions.

A concurrent resolution originating in the House of Representatives is designated “H.Con.Res.”
followed by its individual number.

On approval by both the House of Representatives and Senate,
they are signed by the Clerk of the House and the Secretary of the Senate.

They are not presented to the President for action.

Simple Resolutions
------------------

A matter concerning the operation of either the House of Representatives or Senate
alone is initiated by a simple resolution.

A resolution affecting the House of Representatives is designated “H.Res.” followed by its number.

They are not presented to the President for action.

This command returns only the results portion of the OBBject response.
It contains a list of dictionaries where the base64 encoded content of the
document is under the 'content' key.
/usda/psd_report.examples:

```python
from openbb import obb

```
